name: 4 seasons , 4 girls !!
source:
In spring, Nakao Hando, a first-year high school student, is invited by his childhood friend - Ten Ainame - to help establish her new club: The One Good Deed a Day Commission. Their childhood friend Hohoro Yudokoro is invited as well, along with upperclassman Tsuyuko Hanabishi and junior high school student Garasu Mawatari. 
With his new life beginning in earnest, Nakao's relationship with "her" changes drastically...

translation:
春天，高中一年级学生Nakao Hando受到儿时好友十爱名的邀请，帮助建立她的新俱乐部：每天一件事委员会。他们的儿时好友Hohoro Yudokoro也被邀请，还有学长花菱Tsuyuko和初中生Garasu Mawatari。
随着新生活的正式开始，中尾与“她”的关系发生了巨大的变化……
